title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Business Service - TransportService
description: A service provided by a logistics or transport service provider for the transport of cargo (businessService:TransportService, FEDeRATED Business Service ontology, subclass of LogisticsService), extended by the SIMPLE project with arrival/departure location and driver relationships.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TransportService'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable label (rdfs:label in the source).

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

serviceName.description: Property. businessService:serviceName (inherited from LogisticsService). Each type of logistics service can be described using a name.

deviationDuration.description: Property. businessService:deviationDuration. Deviation on the duration of the transport service.

transportServiceDurationAverage.description: Property. businessService:transportServiceDurationAverage. Average duration of completion for this transport service.

hasLocation.description: Relationship. businessService:hasLocation (inherited from LogisticsService). Location of the logistics service. Range: schema:Place (out of scope of this candidate).

usedTransportMeans.description: Relationship. businessService:usedTransportMeans (inherited from LogisticsService). Transport means involved with the logistics service. Range: DigitalTwin:TransportMeans (out of scope of this candidate).

usedPackagedProducts.description: Relationship. businessService:usedPackagedProducts (inherited from LogisticsService). Packaged products that are part of the logistics service. Range unspecified in the source ontology; modeled generically as a URI relationship.

usedTransportModality.description: Relationship. businessService:usedTransportModality. Describes the transport modality of this transport service. Range: Classifications:TransportModality (out of scope of this candidate).

hasArrivalLocation.description: Relationship. simple-bs:hasArrivalLocation (SIMPLE extension, subPropertyOf businessService:hasLocation). Arrival location of this transport service. Range: DigitalTwin:PhysicalObject, per the SIMPLE ontology's own asserted range (out of scope of this candidate).

hasDepartureLocation.description: Relationship. simple-bs:hasDepartureLocation (SIMPLE extension, subPropertyOf businessService:hasLocation). Departure location of this transport service. Range: DigitalTwin:PhysicalObject (out of scope of this candidate).

involvedDriver.description: Relationship. simple-bs:involvedDriver (SIMPLE extension, subPropertyOf businessService:involvedLogisticsActor). The driver involved in this transport service. Range: LogisticRoles:Driver (out of scope of this candidate).
